title: BENCHMARKING COGNITIVE DOMAINS FOR LLMS: INSIGHTS FROM TAIWANESE HAKKA CULTURE

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs using a newly constructed, domain-specific multiple-choice benchmark dataset focused on Taiwanese Hakka culture. The dataset is structured across the six cognitive domains of Bloom's Taxonomy to measure the models' accuracy, comprehension, and potential for misrepresenting minority cultural knowledge.

Assessing the performance of LLMs on knowledge related to a low-resource language (Hakka) to evaluate their ability to accurately process and retrieve information despite the scarcity of training data compared to mainstream languages.
